text:
maya: Morning — heads up: playbook `onboard-nudge-v2` appears to have sent duplicate onboarding nudges to ~120 accounts overnight. Pattern looks like CRM webhook replay (same external_contact_id, different event_id). Seeing a spike in playbook runner logs around 02:10-02:30 UTC.

jonah: On it. I see a surge in the event_ingest consumer and lots of retries from the legacy connector. The webhook handler for v1 didn't set a stable idempotency key, so replayed events make new runs.

akiko: Ugh, that explains the duplicate runs in the audit table. Quick query to list affected runs:```sql
SELECT account_id, run_id, payload->>'external_event_id' AS ext_id, created_at
FROM playbook_runs
WHERE playbook = 'onboard-nudge-v2'
  AND created_at > now() - interval '12 hours'
  AND payload->>'external_event_id' IS NOT NULL;
```

sam: Proposed short-term mitigation: update runner config to enforce dedupe_by = payload.external_event_id for webhook triggers and add a 24h dedupe TTL. I'll open a patch to the runner and push a hotfix to staging then prod.

ops-bot: Incident created: CS-2026-045 — playbook-duplicates (severity: medium). Pager notified.

jonah: For immediate containment we should throttle the playbook schedule window to 1 run per account per hour and disable the legacy connector retry logic. I can flip a feature flag for the scheduler to apply the throttle.

maya: Good. Also can we cancel follow-up sequences already queued for affected accounts? If they were double-nudged we don't want automatic follow-ups firing.

sam: Yes — plan: (1) add idempotency_key = payload.external_event_id || ':' || playbook_id in runner (2) add endpoint to cancel queued actions by idempotency_key. Quick curl we can run to cancel:```bash
curl -X POST "$CONSOLE_API/playbooks/cancel" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"idempotency_key":"<ext_id>:onboard-nudge-v2"}'
```

akiko: After cancellation and the dedupe fix, we should recompute healthscore for impacted accounts so the transient duplicate events don't skew renewal risk. I can run the backfill script that recalculates the last 7 days.

jonah: I'll coordinate the flag flip and patch rollout. Steps: 1) disable connector retries (now) 2) flip scheduler throttle flag (jonah) 3) deploy runner dedupe hotfix (sam) 4) run cancellation curl for affected ext_ids (maya) 5) healthscore backfill (akiko).

maya: I'll export the list of ext_ids and owners, then DM owners with a short note explaining the noise and actions taken. @sam please ping here when prod hotfix is live. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploy started: runner-hotfix-2026-03-23T08:14Z (sam). CI checks passing.

sam: Hotfix deployed to prod — runner now respects idempotency_key and TTL of 24h. Monitoring event_ingest and dedupe_hits. Initial numbers: dedupe_hits = 118, duplicate_runs prevented = 114.

jonah: Scheduler throttle flag flipped. No new duplicate runs in the last 30m.

akiko: Backfill queued — will take ~2h for 120 accounts. Will post results when done.

maya: Thanks team. Postmortem please capture root cause (legacy connector retries + missing idempotency) and add a unit test for webhook idempotency. Closing incident after backfill and owner notifications. :white_check_mark:
